summary: Floyd-Warshall initialized each undirected edge in only its stored source-to-target direction, producing asymmetric and incorrect shortest-path distances. The fix also initializes the reverse direction for undirected graphs. The regression test added by this commit expects distance 3 from a to c through b; reversing the initialization fix should produce 4 instead. Both proposed regions occur exactly once in their respective Git versions. No tests were executed.
